facts.text: Melanie took her children to a pottery workshop on the previous Friday.

evidence.quote: Last Fri I finally took my kids to a pottery workshop.

facts.text: Melanie and her children made clay sculptures during the pottery workshop, which Melanie described as fun and therapeutic.

evidence.quote: We all made our own pots, it was fun and therapeutic!

facts.text: One of the children created a clay sculpture of a cup with a dog face, which Melanie described as a creative expression of their imagination.

evidence.quote: They made this! [image: a photo of a cup with a dog face on it]
